description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror a DataFrame into Freshservice tickets via search-then-write. Freshservice has no native upsert — GET /tickets/filter by key_field → PUT existing ticket or POST a new one. In-run cache prevents double-post on eventual-consistency lag. Source can be an upstream Dagster asset OR inline SQL / CSV / literal rows.

inputs.description: Either an upstream Dagster asset (via `upstream_asset_key`) OR an inline source config (via `source:` — SQL against a resource, a CSV file path, or literal rows). Each row → one Freshservice ticket (upserted by matching on `key_field` via the Filter Tickets API).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data — the write side effect lands in Freshservice.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source:`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Read the DataFrame inline at run time. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key/database_url_env_var, query}, {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs}, {kind: inline, rows}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

key_field.label: Key Field
key_field.description: Freshservice field (or custom field, prefixed 'custom_fields.') used to match existing tickets via the Filter Tickets API. Must be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Source column → Freshservice field. Values prefixed 'custom_fields.' go into the nested custom_fields sub-object; unprefixed values are top-level ticket fields.

name: Freshservice Ticket Upsert
